summary: Empty Board State Feature Testing - Complete. All features of the redesigned My Schools page (/pipeline) empty state verified working correctly. Backend APIs (suggested-schools, athlete-profile, dashboard, programs, gmail/status) all pass. Frontend UI shows rich empty state with progress strip, personalized welcome hero, action path cards, AI suggestions with match scores, ghost board preview, and social proof strip. Add to Board functionality works - school is added to board and empty state transitions to regular board view.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/dashboard returns athlete_name for personalized greeting
Backend: /api/recruiting-profile returns questionnaire_completed flag
Backend: /api/suggested-schools returns AI matched schools with match_score
Backend: /api/gmail/status returns connected status
Backend: /api/programs returns grouped data with total=0 for empty board user
Backend: /api/programs returns grouped data with total>=1 for pro user
Backend: POST /api/programs successfully adds school to board
Frontend: data-testid='empty-board-state' present when user has no schools
Frontend: data-testid='welcome-hero' present with personalized greeting
Frontend: data-testid='ai-suggestions' present with matched schools
Frontend: data-testid='ghost-board' present with 5 column labels
Frontend: Progress strip shows 4 steps (Create Profile, Add Schools, Email Coaches, Track Replies)
Frontend: 'Create Profile' step marked as done (checkmark) when profile is complete
Frontend: 'Add Schools' highlighted as step 2 with numbered indicator
Frontend: Welcome hero shows 'Let's build TestParent's target list' personalized greeting
Frontend: STEP 2 OF 4 badge displayed
Frontend: Three action path cards visible (AI Recommendations, Browse by Division, Search by Location)
Frontend: AI Suggestions section shows 'Matched for TestParent' with D1 · West Coast
Frontend: Three school suggestions with 91% match scores (Arizona State, Boise State, Brigham Young)
Frontend: '+ Add to Board' buttons present on each suggestion card
Frontend: Add to Board click adds school and transitions to regular board view
Frontend: Toast notification 'Arizona State University added to your board!' appears
Frontend: Ghost board preview shows 5 columns (Needs Outreach, Contacted, Waiting Reply, In Conversation, Offer/Commit)
Frontend: Ghost board shows placeholder cards with skeleton loading pattern
Frontend: Ghost board overlay text 'This is where you'll track every school — from first contact to offer'
Frontend: Social proof strip 'Families using Recruiting HQ track an average of 12 schools and send their first coach email within 48 hours.'
Frontend: Pro user (pro@test.com) board shows UCLA in 'In Conversation' status with 93% match score
Frontend: Pro user board does NOT show empty state (correct behavior)
critical_code_review_comments: EmptyBoardState component is well-structured with separate subcomponents (ProgressStep, ActionPath, SuggestionCard, GhostColumn)
All required data-testid attributes are present (empty-board-state, welcome-hero, ai-suggestions, ghost-board)
API integration is clean - fetches from 4 endpoints in parallel using Promise.all
handleAddSchool properly calls POST /api/programs and triggers onSchoolAdded callback
Suggestion removal on add is done locally via setSuggestions filter (good UX)
Toast notifications implemented with sonner library
CSS uses CSS variables (--t-text, --t-surface) for theming consistency
